prayerExcerpt.en-US: For I am the angel Raphael, one of the seven who stand before the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Pois sou o Anjo Rafael, um dos sete que estão sempre presentes, diante do Senhor.

meta.face: A radiant youthful angel, beardless and ageless, of the same family as the set's Michael and Gabriel but plainly a different face: a HEART-SHAPED face — a broad, smooth brow tapering to a NARROW, softly pointed chin, a slender straight nose, large warm HAZEL eyes under softly arched AUBURN brows, delicate high cheekbones, a gentle closed smile; thick, short AUBURN (copper-red) curls clustering round the head and over the ears, not reaching the shoulders; the head turned and inclined down toward the boy with a kindly gaze. Not Michael's golden curls and rosy oval face, not Gabriel's long light-brown waves.
meta.basis: An angel has no likeness. The card takes the Western type of 'Tobias and the Angel' (Verrocchio's workshop, National Gallery; Titian's at the Accademia): a young winged traveller leading the boy with the fish, and the dog, from Tob 5:5 and 6:1-9. Titian's auburn curls set him apart from the set's golden-haired Michael and brown-haired Gabriel, whose wings, halo and painted manner he shares.
